nodes.name: EditTaskProperties

nodes.name: LinkTasks
nodes.description: Draws the tentative dependency line from the predecessor edge to the pointer (UC-004).

nodes.name: RecordActuals
nodes.description: Decides where the actual begins when a progress marker is pulled (UC-005).

nodes.name: FindDelays
nodes.description: Answers how many working days a task is late (UC-006).

nodes.name: ShowRange
nodes.description: Decides whether a stored view place still names a place (UC-007).

nodes.name: AnnotateSchedule
nodes.description: Places the free end of a comment box on a task group (UC-008).

nodes.name: ShowConfidentialSchedule
nodes.description: Decides who the watermark names and whether an answer lifts it (UC-009).

nodes.name: ExchangeWithWbsMaster
nodes.description: Picks the tasks dropped for an unusable date and tells work values apart (UC-010).

nodes.name: SaveAndShareDocument
nodes.description: Stamps the saved document with the time it is written (UC-011).

nodes.name: MergeSchedules
nodes.description: Names the tasks missing since the last import of the same master (UC-014).

nodes.name: OperateThroughAgentApi
nodes.description: Reads a refusal of the write path as the reason and rule the agent gets (UC-012).

nodes.name: RunDelayDiagnostics
nodes.description: Computes the delay diagnosis by the document calendar (UC-015).
